_doc: Training lessons. Each step: text (instruction), hint, done (conditions that all hold), hold (s), warn [{when, say, level}], track [{name, metric, reduce}], record [{name, metric}], gauges [{label, metric, min, max, target, tol, unit}]. Conditions are [metric, op, value]; ops >= <= > < == abs< abs> between. Metrics: ias gs agl alt vs hdg bank pitch throttle rpm flaps wow brake pitch_in along cross gp gp_dev dist hoops, and d_<metric> = change since the step began (d_hdg is wrapped to +/-180). Grades: [{label, source rec|trk, name, good [lo,hi], ok [lo,hi], unit}].

lessons.title: Takeoff
lessons.summary: Line up, take off straight, rotate at the right speed and climb away at Vy.
learn: Using full power and keeping straight with the rudder

steps.title: Full power
steps.text: You are lined up on runway 28. Open the throttle smoothly to full power (PgUp).
steps.hint: Full throttle gives about 2,300 RPM. Keep your feet ready on the rudder.

steps.title: Stay on the centreline
steps.text: Keep the nose on the centreline with the rudder (Z / X). The aircraft pulls left as power comes in.
steps.hint: Small, quick rudder taps. Look at the far end of the runway, not at the nose.

steps.title: Rotate at 55 knots
steps.text: At 55 knots, ease the yoke back (↓) and let the aircraft fly off.
steps.hint: Pull gently. About 7° nose-up is enough; do not yank it off the ground.

steps.title: Climb at Vy
steps.text: Hold about 10° nose-up and climb at 74 knots (Vy), the best rate of climb.
steps.hint: Speed too low: lower the nose a little. Too high: raise it. Wings level.

steps.title: Reach 500 ft
steps.text: Keep climbing straight ahead to 500 ft above the runway.
steps.hint: Hold 74 knots. You can trim (Home / End) so you do not have to hold the yoke.

lessons.title: Cruise
lessons.summary: Level flight, cruise power, trim, a standard turn, and climbs and descents.
learn: Holding altitude with small pitch changes
Setting cruise power and trimming hands-off
Climbing and descending by a set amount

steps.title: Level flight
steps.text: Hold your altitude for 15 seconds. Put the nose on the horizon; small pitch changes make big differences.
steps.hint: If you are drifting up, ease the nose down a little (↑). Make a small correction, then wait to see the effect.

steps.title: Cruise power
steps.text: Set cruise power: about 2,300 RPM (PgUp / PgDn). Keep the aircraft level while you do it.
steps.hint: Changing power changes the pitch. Add a little back pressure as you reduce, a little forward as you add.

steps.title: Trim
steps.text: Trim (Home / End) until the aircraft flies level on its own. Then take your hands off the keys for 8 seconds.
steps.hint: Trim removes the pressure so you do not have to hold the yoke. Make small trim changes, one at a time.

steps.title: Turn left 90°
steps.text: Bank left about 20° (←) and keep your altitude. Roll out when you reach the beacon.
steps.hint: Pull back slightly as you bank to hold altitude. Start rolling out about 10° before the heading.

steps.title: Climb 500 ft
steps.text: Full power (PgUp), pitch up and hold 74 knots (Vy). Climb 500 ft.
steps.hint: Aim for about 10° nose-up. Level off by lowering the nose and reducing power when you get there.

steps.title: Descend 500 ft
steps.text: Reduce power to about 1,900 RPM, lower the nose slightly and descend 500 ft at about 500 fpm.
steps.hint: Keep the speed from building: do not let it go over 110 knots.

steps.title: Level off
steps.text: Level off and hold the altitude for 8 seconds.
steps.hint: Start easing the nose up about 50 ft before your level-off altitude.

lessons.title: Landing
lessons.summary: Fly a stable approach on the 3° glide path, flare and land on the runway.
learn: Following the glide path and centreline
The flare and a smooth touchdown

steps.title: Slow down
steps.text: Reduce power (PgDn) to about 1,700 RPM and slow to 70 knots. Point the aircraft at the runway.
steps.hint: Lower the nose slightly as the power comes off to hold the glide.

steps.title: Flaps and trim
steps.text: Extend flaps to 20° (] or F7 twice) and trim for 65 knots.
steps.hint: Flaps down: the nose may pitch. Retrim (Home / End) so you can fly with light hands.

steps.title: Fly the glide path
steps.text: Fly the 3° glide path to the runway: aim at the numbers and fly through the rings. Two red, two white on the PAPI.
steps.hint: High: reduce power, lower the nose. Low: add a little power. Keep 65 knots with the pitch, the path with the power.

warn.say: High. Reduce power, lower the nose

steps.title: Cross the threshold
steps.text: Cross the threshold at about 60 knots. Start closing the throttle (PgDn) as you reach the runway.
steps.hint: Keep looking at the far end of the runway, not at the ground in front of you.

steps.title: Flare and touch down
steps.text: Level the wings, raise the nose to flare and let the aircraft settle. Hold the nose-high attitude as the speed bleeds off.
steps.hint: Throttle to idle. Rate of descent slows as you pull back gently; do not balloon.

steps.title: Roll out
steps.text: Keep straight with the rudder and brake gently (B) down to a walking pace.
steps.hint: Nose wheel steering with the rudder. Brake smoothly, not hard.
